tagline.en: Out of BETA. 22 games, two currencies, one arcade.
tagline.id: Keluar dari BETA. 22 game, dua mata uang, satu arcade.

items.en: Neon Arcade leaves BETA: 1.0.0 Release, launched 12 October 2026, 21:00 UTC.
items.id: Neon Arcade keluar dari BETA: Rilis 1.0.0, diluncurkan 12 Oktober 2026, 21:00 UTC.

items.en: The release trailer plays once when you first sign in. Watch it again from the update log.
items.id: Trailer rilis diputar sekali saat pertama masuk. Tonton lagi dari update log.

items.en: A new update log with the whole journey from 1.0.0 BETA to today.
items.id: Update log baru dengan seluruh perjalanan dari 1.0.0 BETA sampai sekarang.

items.en: Slice: swipe across a fruit to cut it, like a real fruit slicer.
items.id: Slice: geser melewati buah untuk memotongnya, seperti fruit slicer sungguhan.

items.en: Turned-off games show a proper page instead of a pop-up.
items.id: Game yang dimatikan menampilkan halaman sendiri, bukan pop-up.

items.en: MAX bet now uses your Loyalty Card bet limit, not your whole balance.
items.id: Bet MAX sekarang mengikuti batas taruhan Loyalty Card, bukan seluruh saldo.

items.en: Withdrawals are AG only. AC→AG exchange and AG/AC transfer limits now grow with your Loyalty Card.
items.id: Penarikan hanya AG. Batas tukar AC→AG dan kirim AG/AC sekarang naik sesuai Loyalty Card.

items.en: Hold Space (or hold the screen) for 3 seconds to skip the trailer.
items.id: Tahan Space (atau tahan layar) 3 detik untuk melewati trailer.

items.en: New Arcade Gems icon, tighter logo and header.
items.id: Ikon Arcade Gems baru, logo dan header lebih rapat.

items.en: Global Chat and live feeds are busier with house players. Their mini profile says they are house players.
items.id: Global Chat dan live feed lebih ramai dengan pemain house. Mini profil mereka menandai sebagai pemain house.

items.en: Settings: change your sign-in email while it is not verified yet.
items.id: Pengaturan: ganti email login selama belum diverifikasi.

items.en: One email can hold up to 3 accounts. Password reset lets you pick which account.
items.id: Satu email bisa dipakai sampai 3 akun. Reset password bisa pilih akunnya.

items.en: New Neon Arcade logo: an Arcade Chip ring around the arcade A.
items.id: Logo Neon Arcade baru: cincin Arcade Chip mengelilingi huruf A arcade.

items.en: A new 2-minute release video, also on the home banner. Hold the centre button 3 seconds to skip.
items.id: Video rilis baru 2 menit, juga ada di banner beranda. Tahan tombol tengah 3 detik untuk lewati.

items.en: Snake: the lose sound plays together with the result. The NEON/ARCADE logo no longer overlaps.
items.id: Snake: suara kalah sekarang bersamaan dengan hasil. Logo NEON/ARCADE tidak lagi bertumpuk.
